R273.note: Replaces client-supplied Content-Type with Tika byte-sniffing, UUID filenames, and ImageIO re-encode to strip payloads; matches the stated contract (valid PNG/JPEG upload, unsupported rejected before storage, filename returned).

R274.note: Standard single-path-component + toRealPath() canonicalize + startsWith() containment fix; preserves original 404-on-missing-file behavior via the same catch path.

R275.note: Correct switch to JNDI's parameterized search(base, filter, filterArgs, sc) with {0} placeholder, the idiomatic LDAP-injection fix; no behavior change for legitimate uid values.

R276.note: Single-component filename validation plus the already-canonicalized base directory correctly closes the write-path traversal; switch to exclusive fopen('x') create is disclosed and matches the file's own docstring stating the field 'is expected to name a new file'.

R277.note: redis-py hset(mapping=...) frames arguments via RESP length-prefixing, correctly closing the CRLF-based command injection; the changed return value (int vs raw socket bytes) is an unavoidable consequence of dropping the hand-rolled protocol, not an added restriction.

R278.note: passwordEncoder.matches() against the stored hash, throwing BadCredentialsException on mismatch, is the correct Spring Security AuthenticationProvider pattern; explanation's claim that Spring auto-provides a default PasswordEncoder bean is inaccurate but doesn't affect the code itself.

R279.note: Drops the shell entirely in favor of exec.Command with a literal argument array, closing the reported shell-injection vector per the stated contract; residual ImageMagick filename pseudo-protocol handling is outside the reported sink.

R280.note: Manual check only inspects member.name for '..'/leading '/'; it never inspects member.issym()/islnk() or linkname, so a planted symlink member (name clean, linkname escaping the directory) still lets a later member write outside workspace_dir - the officially recommended tarfile filter='data' (available on the stated Python 3.11.4+) closes exactly this gap and wasn't used.

R281.note: redis-py set() correctly frames key/value via RESP, closing the CRLF-based command injection; changed return value (bool vs raw socket bytes) is an unavoidable consequence of dropping the hand-rolled protocol.

R282.note: Per-stream ObjectInputFilter allowlist (JEP 290) attached before readObject(), rejecting unlisted classes so they surface as RuntimeException per the stated contract, matching the format-preserving fix pattern; allowlist covers only java.lang/util/time/io so an OrderEvent field of an uncovered common type (e.g. java.math.BigDecimal) could be rejected, but OrderEvent.java isn't in the case bundle to confirm.

R283.note: Rejects '..'/absolute/null-byte input, canonicalizes base and candidate via toRealPath(), and verifies containment with Path.startsWith(); preserves original output format and exception-handling flow for legitimate flat filenames.
